description:
FOUND s473t6c (#1501 ROUND 10).

t/op/grep.t's causeless rows are "grep void post", "grep scalar post",
"grep list post", "block map void 2", "block map void 3" and "proper error on
variable as block".

The last one is NS:Error compatibility for invalid Perl input (`grep $coderef,
@list` is a compile-time error in perl).  The other five are context: a
`grep`/`map` used as a STATEMENT, or with a postfix `for`/`if`, must still
evaluate its block the right number of times and yield nothing in void context.

Measure first with a counter in the block; the failure may be that PCL builds
the result list in void context (a cost as well as a divergence), which would
make this a Target-A item too.
subject: `grep` / `map` in VOID and in postfix context: the block runs, but the row asserts what it returns and how often (op/grep.t, 6 rows)
